title: Adding things up in a loop
summary: Declare the total before the loop, update it inside.

steps.title: An accumulator
steps.say: To add up numbers, keep a running total. It has to live **outside** the loop, or it would restart at 0 every pass.

marks.label: before the loop: survives every pass
after the loop: the full sum

board.caption: sumTo(5) = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 15

steps.title: Counting matches
steps.say: Counting is the same shape, but you only add 1 when a test passes.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `public static int sumTo` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find public static int sumTo with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: Write `sumTo`, then `countDivisibleByThree` in the same shape.

steps.title: Run it
steps.say: Click the **Run** button (▷) at the top right of the file. The output appears in the terminal at the bottom.

waitFor.hint: run the program and read the output.
